result: Release 3.7.7. The version and build id are bumped in all eight places - content.js, connections.js, applicants.js, src/background.ts, src/react/popup.tsx (EXPECTED_BUILD_ID), scripts/build.mjs (both the buildId and the version field), manifest.json and package.json - to 3.7.7 and 2026-08-03-react-v3.7.7, the date component being today rather than the one carried over from the last release. CHANGELOG.md gained a 3.7.7 entry covering all four requests and saying what was actually broken in each rather than only what changed, since two of the four were re-reports of fixes that had already been attempted. CHECKS.md gained a 3.7.7 section listing the nine commands actually run and their real output (the baseline 395, then 396/398/400/405/405 after each task, and the build-file count going 30 to 31 with theme.css), what each of the six new tests asserts, why each of the seven changed tests had to change, and six things only a live run can confirm - led by the two the console line now answers directly. MEMORY.md gained ten durable entries, PROJECT_STATUS.md leads with the four changes and names the live questions in order, TECH_STACK.md gained five constraints (do not detect an SPA arrival by polling alone, do not consume a trigger before the work succeeds, do not read the resource timeline without a floor, do not answer downloaded on a download id alone, do not put page styling in theme.css), and README.md documents the reload-free return by all three routes and the resume being saved as a file rather than previewed.
